info.title: GG Requestz API
info.description: Game request management platform with IGDB integration, watchlist, and ROMM library support

bearerAuth.description: API key authentication with format: `ggr_<your-api-key>`. Scopes are enforced per endpoint: a key missing the required scope receives 403 with the scope named in `required_scope`, and endpoints not listed in the scope table are unavailable to API keys entirely. A key with the `*` scope satisfies every endpoint. See the scope table in docs/API.md; the source of truth is src/lib/apiScopes.js. (OpenAPI cannot express scopes for `http bearer` schemes, so they are not declared per operation here.)
